metadata.title: Mango Jam | Without Preservatives | Home recipe
metadata.description:
Come summer and the market it flooded with mangoes. Those of you who have mango trees at home would have faced the problem of plenty. This season the mango tree in our home bore plenty of mangoes to eat, share and quite a lot got left out too. I made jam without the use of any preservatives in this video. 

Ingredients

Mango pulp - 1 kg
Mango chunks - 200 gms
Sugar - 1/2 kg or more as  per the sweetness of mango
Apple - 1
Juice of one medium sized lemon
